title: AI toolkit collection
description: Manifest of a package: which topics (profile files) the viewer shows, in which order, and with which icon. Each topic is one profile that follows catalog.schema.json. Use cases (recipes) of each profile become the pages of the viewer. The viewer reads collection version 1.0 only.

topics.description: Order matters: it is the order of the dashboard and of the Back and Next navigation.

id.description: Stable slug used in page links. Never change it after publishing.

file.description: File name of the profile next to the collection. No paths.

icon.description: Icon name from the viewer's icon set, shown on the dashboard.

x-crossReferenceRules: every listed file exists next to the collection and validates against catalog.schema.json (checked by the validate script and the viewer)
